description:
The `TrustBadge` component (`results-explorer/src/components/TrustBadge.tsx`)
was added in PR #53 and integrated into ResultDetail, BenchmarkIndex,
PlatformIndex, and Compare pages. Unit tests cover the data flow from
pipeline → manifest → page props, but the rendered visual output has never
been eyeballed in a real browser build. CSS regressions, color contrast
issues, and compact-vs-full variant misuse will only surface in a real
render.

This item builds the explorer locally, walks all four pages with seeded
corpus data covering every trust label (`maintainer-run`,
`community-submission`, `ci`, `local`, plus an unknown label fallback),
captures screenshots, and files visual bugs found.

anti_patterns.dont: commit the fixture bundles from w1
anti_patterns.why: they would pollute the curated maintainer corpus; they exist only on a local branch that gets discarded.

anti_patterns.dont: silently fix CSS/component issues during this verification pass
anti_patterns.why: that conflates verification with implementation; file a follow-up TODO and address it as a separate change.
graceful degradation for future trust tiers (Phase 3) is the most likely source of regression.

preserves.behavior: Existing TrustBadge component API and props (verification only - no code changes unless filing/fixing a defect).
The seed corpus on `published-results` (do not commit fixture bundles).

work_units.notes:
The current seed corpus is all `maintainer-run`. To verify all variants,
temporarily add 4 fixture bundles in a local-only branch (do NOT commit
to main):
  - 1 with no sidecar → maintainer-run (already exists)
  - 1 with `submission-manifest.json` sidecar → community-submission
  - 1 with explicit `trust_label: ci` injected via pipeline override
  - 1 with `trust_label: local`
  - 1 with `trust_label: experimental` (unknown - confirms graceful fallback)
Use the existing TPC-H SF 0.01 DuckDB bundle as the source; only the
metadata/sidecar varies.
work_units.summary: Seed local corpus with one bundle per trust label

work_units.notes:
cd results-explorer
npm install
npm run build
npx serve dist
# Open http://localhost:3000/results/ in Chrome, Firefox, Safari
work_units.summary: Build and serve the explorer locally

work_units.notes:
For each page, confirm: badge renders, color matches spec
(Maintainer=blue, Community=yellow, CI=gray, Local=gray, Unknown=neutral
fallback), text label readable, compact variant fits inside table cells
without wrapping or overflow.

Pages and locations:
  - ResultDetail (full badge, line ~95 of ResultDetail.tsx) - visit one
    URL per trust label
  - BenchmarkIndex (compact, line ~127) - Source column shows badge per row
  - PlatformIndex (compact, line ~135) - same
  - Compare (compact, line ~165) - beside fastest indicator

Save screenshots to `_project/handoffs/trust-badge-screenshots-<date>/`
organized by `<page>-<label>.png`. 5 labels × 4 pages = 20 screenshots
minimum.
work_units.summary: Verify badge rendering on all 4 pages and capture screenshots

work_units.notes:
Re-open one ResultDetail page per browser. Confirm color, font, and
layout match Chrome. Document any browser-specific issues
(Safari often differs on flexbox / SVG sizing). One screenshot per
browser is sufficient unless a regression is found.

- For each visual issue, create a focused bug TODO referencing the
  offending screenshot and the source file/line.
- Update step #1 of `_project/handoffs/results-publishing-handoff-2026-04-04.md`
  to mark TrustBadge verification complete and link to the screenshot
  directory.
- Discard the local-only fixture branch from w1 - DO NOT merge fixture
  bundles into the real corpus.
work_units.summary: File defects and update handoff status
